$comment: v1.1 — frozen per docs/14-implementation-plan-ph5.md Step 3 (R2), same discipline as finding.schema.json (Step 2's A3): publish before an external MCP client depends on the shape. Mirrors pkg/recon.ReconResult exactly. confidence values here ("high"|"medium"|"low") mirror pkg/agenttask.Confidence's band convention, NOT Finding.confidence (a distinct, detector-set, two-value field) — docs/91-research-recon-phase.md already corrected this exact conflation once. v1.1 (Step 3b): TechFact.host added as required — R8's decision engine needs to know which host produced a tech signal to set a PlanTree leaf's Target; a real omission in v1, corrected before Phase 6's MCP server (the only planned external consumer) exists. v1.2 (Phase 6 Step 3, D2): optional `policy` object added — Wave 0's fetched security.txt/robots.txt signals, input to the pkg/preflight program-policy pre-flight check; a backward-compatible additive field, absent unless Wave 0 found something. v1.3 (demo batch, LT-30b): EndpointFact gains optional `body_len`/`content_type`/`title` — response-shape signal probeCommonPaths/httpx measure, so a downstream soft-404/SPA-catch-all check can tell a real distinct resource from a shell served for every path; all additive, omitted when unmeasured. v1.4 (Phase 7 Step 4, D6): optional `uniform_response` object — set by Wave 3 when a host answers every probe with one generic page (a WAF/bot/auth block wall or a SPA/bucket catch-all), consumed by the decision engine (LT-58) and the scan engine's corpus short-circuit (LT-59); additive, absent on a normally-routing host. v1.5 (near-term batch, LT-68): optional `app_surface` object — recon's synthesised none/thin/full verdict on whether there is a live application worth planning against; additive, `plan`/`scan` echo it to stderr. v1.6 (Phase 8 Step 6, LT-64): EndpointFact gains optional `redirect_chain`/`final_url` — set only when httpx followed a redirect to a different host; `status_code` is then the first-hop 3xx, and body_len/content_type/title/tech are omitted, so a cross-host redirect isn't recorded as the target's own 200. Additive, absent on the common no-cross-host-redirect case. v1.7 (Phase 8 Step 6 second tranche, LT-40): a new EndpointFact `source` value `"api-spec"` — routes walked out of a reachable OpenAPI/Swagger JSON document (`paths`/`parameters`), path templating kept verbatim (`/users/{id}`) and documented query keys appended keyless; no schema-shape change (source is a free-form string). LT-61 adds a `cdn-edge:` line to a HostFact's `notes` when the host's ASN is a known CDN edge network — also no shape change.
title: ReconResult

target.description: The target URL Run was given.

api_spec.description: Always null in v1 — generic OpenAPI/GraphQL spec parsing is an explicit, named scope cut (docs/14-implementation-plan-ph5.md Step 3's Context section); this field is reserved for a later pass, not yet populated.

out_of_scope.description: Hosts discovered but excluded per --scope — feeds doc90's B4 scope-creep gate once Phase 6 wires it in.

policy.description: Raw, unparsed policy-relevant artifacts Wave 0 fetches (security.txt body, robots.txt disallow-all) — input to pkg/preflight's D2 pre-flight check (doc15 Step 3). Advisory only; never a block on its own.

uniform_response.description: Set by Wave 3 when a host answers effectively every request with one generic page rather than routing — a WAF/bot/auth block wall or a SPA/bucket catch-all (Phase 7 Step 4 D6). Absent on a normally-routing host.

app_surface.description: Recon's one-line verdict on whether there is a live application worth planning against, synthesised from uniform_response, how many endpoints answered 2xx, and whether anything was fingerprinted (docs/follow-up.md LT-68). Additive; absent only on a result produced before v1.5.

warnings.description: Non-fatal degrade notices, e.g. a missing recon binary skipping its wave — inspectable, not just stderr text.

security_txt.description: security.txt body, truncated to a scan-only length; substring-scanned for advisory warnings, never parsed.

body_len.description: Response body length in bytes, as measured by probeCommonPaths' own GET or httpx -cl. Omitted (0) when recon didn't measure it — v1.3, LT-30b.

content_type.description: Response Content-Type (value only, charset param kept as-is), from probeCommonPaths or httpx -ct. Omitted when unmeasured — v1.3, LT-30b.

title.description: HTML <title>, from httpx -title. Omitted when unmeasured — v1.3, LT-30b.

source.description: e.g. "wave0-security-txt", "httpx", "katana-crawl", "wave3-common-path-probe", "wave3-auth-boundary-heuristic", "robots-txt", "sitemap-xml", "api-spec" (routes walked from a reachable OpenAPI/Swagger JSON doc — v1.7, LT-40).

redirect_chain.description: One "<status> <url>" line per redirect hop — set only when httpx followed a redirect to a different host (v1.6, LT-64).

final_url.description: Where a cross-host redirect chain landed. status_code stays the first-hop 3xx; the destination's shape/tech are not attributed here (v1.6, LT-64).

host.description: Which host produced this tech signal — added in v1.1.

canary_status.description: HTTP status the guaranteed-nonexistent canary path returned.

blocked_ratio.description: Fraction of this host's Wave 3 probes that came back intercepted (canary-shaped or 401/403/429) — ~1.0 means recon is blind here (LT-62).

verdict.description: "none" = nothing to scan from this vantage (a wall, or no real content and no fingerprint); "thin" = reachable but sparse; "full" = a real mapped surface.

Confidence.description: Mirrors pkg/agenttask.Confidence's string values — not Finding.confidence.
